title: Counter Reference: Withdrawal Allowance and Excess Withdrawal Charges by Savings Tier
content:
Every tier of Savings & Money Market Accounts carries a per-cycle allowance of counted withdrawals, a charge for each counted withdrawal beyond it, a cap on how many such charges a single statement cycle may carry, and a list of the channels that count toward the allowance. Two further parameters state whether an overdraft protection transfer to checking counts toward the allowance, and whether the tier may be linked as the overdraft protection source of a checking account.

| Tier | Free counted withdrawals per cycle | Excess withdrawal fee | Most excess withdrawal fees per cycle | Overdraft protection transfer counts | May be an overdraft protection source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Starter Savings | 6 | 10.00 USD | 6 | yes | yes |
| Statement Savings | 6 | 10.00 USD | 6 | yes | yes |
| Goal Builder Savings | 2 | 10.00 USD | 6 | yes | no |
| Money Market Account | 6 | 15.00 USD | 6 | yes | yes |
| Premier Money Market | 6 | 10.00 USD | 6 | no | yes |
| Private Client Money Market | unlimited | 0.00 USD | 0 | no | yes |

### Channels that count toward the allowance

On Starter Savings, Statement Savings and Goal Builder Savings the counted channels are online transfer, mobile banking transfer, telephone banking transfer, ACH debit and domestic wire.

On Money Market Account, Premier Money Market and Private Client Money Market the counted channels are online transfer, mobile banking transfer, telephone banking transfer, ACH debit, money market check and domestic wire.

Withdrawals made in person at a branch and withdrawals at an ATM are never counted channels on any tier of this product.

### Reading the schedule

Goal Builder Savings is the narrowest allowance in the range at 2 counted withdrawals a cycle, against 6 on four other tiers; Private Client Money Market carries the value unlimited, with an excess withdrawal fee of 0.00 USD and a cap of 0 such fees in a cycle.

Money Market Account carries the highest excess withdrawal fee of the range at 15.00 USD; the other charging tiers are at 10.00 USD.
